title: Backlight
description: The backlight module displays the current backlight level.

placeholders.description: The current brightness in percent, adjusted with a power curve to better match perceived brightness.
The icon from format-icons chosen according to {percent}.
The icon from format-icons chosen according to {percent_exp}.

interval.label: Refresh every
interval.doc: The interval in which information gets polled.
interval.description: How often the module updates its information.

device.label: Device
device.doc: The name of the preferred backlight device to display. If left empty, a device will be chosen automatically. Both screen backlights (the udev backlight subsystem) and keyboard backlights (LEDs in the udev leds subsystem, e.g. white:kbd_backlight) are supported; name such an LED here to control it. When left empty, a screen backlight is always preferred for automatic selection.
device.description: The name of the preferred backlight device to display. If left empty, a device will be chosen automatically. Both screen backlights (the udev backlight subsystem) and keyboard backlights (LEDs in the udev leds subsystem, e.g. white:kbd_backlight) are supported; name such an LED here to control it. When left empty, a screen backlight is always preferred for automatic selection.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed. On {} data gets inserted.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in characters the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.

min-length.label: Minimum length
min-length.doc: The minimum length in characters the module should accept.
min-length.description: Keep the module at least this wide, so the bar doesn't jump around when the text changes.

align.label: Text position
align.doc: The alignment of the label within the module, where 0 is left-aligned and 1 is right-aligned. If the module is rotated, it will follow the flow of the text.
align.description: Where the text sits inside the module: 0 is left, 0.5 is center, 1 is right.

justify.label: Line alignment
justify.doc: The alignment of the text within the module's label, allowing options 'left', 'right', or 'center' to define the positioning.
justify.description: How lines are aligned when the text has more than one line.

rotate.label: Rotation
rotate.doc: Positive value to rotate the text label (in 90 degree increments).
rotate.description: Rotate the text. Mostly useful on vertical bars.

states.label: Levels
states.doc: A number of backlight states which get activated on certain brightness levels. See waybar-states(5).
states.description: Give names to value ranges (for example "warning" at 30 and "critical" at 15). You can then use a different format or color for each level.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: Command to execute when the module is clicked.
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

on-click-middle.label: Middle click runs
on-click-middle.doc: Command to execute when middle-clicked on the module using mouse scroll wheel.
on-click-middle.description: A command to run when you click the module with the mouse wheel.

on-click-right.label: Right click runs
on-click-right.doc: Command to execute when the module is right-clicked.
on-click-right.description: A command to run when you right-click the module.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

on-scroll-up.label: Scroll up runs
on-scroll-up.doc: Command to execute when performing a scroll up on the module. This replaces the default behaviour of brightness control.
on-scroll-up.description: A command to run when you scroll up over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

on-scroll-down.label: Scroll down runs
on-scroll-down.doc: Command to execute when performing a scroll down on the module. This replaces the default behaviour of brightness control.
on-scroll-down.description: A command to run when you scroll down over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

smooth-scrolling-threshold.label: Scroll sensitivity
smooth-scrolling-threshold.doc: Threshold to be used when scrolling.
smooth-scrolling-threshold.description: How far you must scroll on a touchpad before something happens. Higher means less sensitive.

reverse-scrolling.label: Reverse touchpad scrolling
reverse-scrolling.doc: Option to reverse the scroll direction for devices other than a mouse (touchpad, trackpad, etc).
reverse-scrolling.description: Swap up and down when scrolling with a touchpad.

reverse-mouse-scrolling.label: Reverse mouse scrolling
reverse-mouse-scrolling.doc: Option to reverse the scroll direction for mice.
reverse-mouse-scrolling.description: Swap up and down when scrolling with a mouse wheel.

scroll-step.label: Scroll step
scroll-step.doc: The speed at which to change the brightness when scrolling. Expressed in percentage points of the device's maximum brightness. Positive steps are rounded to the nearest device unit (half units round up), with a minimum of one unit and a maximum of the full brightness range. Zero, negative, or non-finite steps disable scroll adjustment.
scroll-step.description: The speed at which to change the brightness when scrolling. Expressed in percentage points of the device's maximum brightness. Positive steps are rounded to the nearest device unit (half units round up), with a minimum of one unit and a maximum of the full brightness range. Zero, negative, or non-finite steps disable scroll adjustment.

min-brightness.label: Min brightness
min-brightness.doc: The minimum brightness when scrolling down, as a percentage of the device's maximum brightness. Values are clamped to [0, 100]. The lower limit is the smallest device value whose percentage is at least the configured minimum. Scrolling down leaves a brightness already below this limit unchanged. Non-finite values disable scroll adjustment.
min-brightness.description: The minimum brightness when scrolling down, as a percentage of the device's maximum brightness. Values are clamped to [0, 100]. The lower limit is the smallest device value whose percentage is at least the configured minimum. Scrolling down leaves a brightness already below this limit unchanged. Non-finite values disable scroll adjustment.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: Text to be displayed in the tooltip.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There need to be an element of type GtkMenu with id menu
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: The actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.
